# vita-memio 1.5.1

A fix release with one new option. **Please update:** in 1.5.0, resetting Tuning in the overlay could restart the console.

Everything is in one archive, `vita-memio-1.5.1.zip`; see *Install or update* below.

## Fixed

- **Restart from the overlay.** Resetting *Tuning* (Triangle twice), and sometimes *Save*, could restart the console. Now the overlay only asks, and the plugin writes those files from where it has room to do so safely.
- **Verify transfers spoiled what Adaptive learned.** With *Verify transfers* on, every read is done twice, so read ahead looked slower than it is. Adaptive could then switch read ahead off for a game and keep it off after Verify was switched off. Now Adaptive and Tuning learn nothing while Verify is on. If a game was affected, reset *Tuning* once (Triangle twice) to start its learning again.
- A rare race in read ahead of 32 KiB reads when two threads read the same card. It could waste a read, never give wrong data.

## New

- **Low kernel memory** (Settings, shown only while both the SD2Vita and the memory card are on): the two share one set of buffers, which leaves 384 KiB more kernel memory for other plugins. The app in front comes first: its reads from either card are sped up in turn, while other apps' reads go the standard way. Copying between the cards gains less. It takes effect after a restart and is off by default.
- **Read ahead for the app in front only.** Other apps' reads, such as the system's or music in the background, are still sped up, but they no longer use or break the game's read ahead.

## Changed

- **Less kernel memory:** the HUD module takes about 7 KiB less and frees its drawing buffers while closed. The log's counters take memory only once the log has been on (about 3 KiB).
- **Log:** the real size of each memory block, and a summary of other apps' reads per session.

## Results in games

These are the plugin's own estimates from its log (PCH-1000, microSD in an SD2Vita), from one short session per game. *Saved* is the time read ahead took off the game's waits for the card. They are rough figures, not stopwatch measurements.

| Game | Normal | Low kernel memory |
|---|---:|---:|
| PCSG01179 | +35.7 s (84%) | +39.7 s (85%) |
| GTA San Andreas (port) | +22.3 s (64%) | +22.3 s (64%) |
| PCSB00554 | +1.4 s (19%) | +1.5 s (17%) |
| PCSB01030 | +1.1 s (10%) | +1.2 s (11%) |
| PCSF00024 | +0.8 s (4%) | +0.8 s (4%) |

## Install or update

Unpack `vita-memio-1.5.1.zip`. Copy `vitamemio_kernel.skprx`, `vitamemio_hud.skprx` and `vitamemio.suprx` to `ur0:tai/` and restart; always update all three together. Settings and everything learned from 1.5.0 are kept. For a new install, see the [README](https://github.com/Osaul4ik/vita-memio#install).
